title: The Divine Archer and the Arrows of Love
english: Because the body was separated from the soul by the transgression of the first man, the body was being distressed as if to undergo a long-lasting sojourn; instead of existing for one day, God has doubly repaid by raising and giving the soul its body, so that it does not merely receive the same thing, but instead of a corrupt and dishonorable and weak and psychic body, an incorruptible, strong, and glorious body, and this very body is spiritual.

The one paying attention to the reading of the God-breathed oracles and many other things will understand how God doubly repays the one having been relocated for one day. Regarding what is explicitly said: the people, having been relocated into the captivity of enemies, were not only redeemed, but also ruled over those who had seized them; when this happened, those who had been slightly afflicted had joy.

Zechariah 9:13-14: 'Because I have bent my bow against you, Judah, I have filled Ephraim, and I will raise up your children, Zion, against the children of the Greeks, and I will touch you as a warrior's sword. And the Lord shall be over them.' The Father bent a bow for Himself for the Savior rising out of the tribe of Judah, from which He releases arrows aiming at salvation. And see the difference: the destroying bow of Ephraim is named after being used against the enemy. For it is said in Psalm 67:13 regarding satanic powers of enemies and all the heterodox: 'Ephraim, bending and shooting with the bow, how were they turned in the day of battle,' having grown weak and being overthrown, clearly showing the shattering of the shields? For it is said: 'Their sword shall enter into their own heart, and their bows shall be shattered.' The shattering of the bows is the ruling principle of the combatants, from which evil words are sent, the judgment of unheeded arrows about which the divine word says: 'Their tongue, shooting a missile, is deceitful, their words...'
The words of those promising false knowledge are full of the venom of a serpent, killing those who receive them.

But such are not the arrows of the powerful Savior, about which it is said in the forty-fourth Psalm regarding the blessed and excellent archer: 'Your arrows are sharp, mighty' (Ps 44:3), which instills divine love in those struck by them, as if speaking like a blessed bride possessing divine love: 'I am pierced by love.' And behold the paradox: the same Savior is the bow, the archer, and the arrow. For in the present prophetic word spoken to Him by God, it is said: 'I have bent you, Judah, as my bow' (Jer 48:10); but in the Psalm, those praising Him say: 'Your arrows are sharp, mighty' (Ps 44:3); and He Himself says about Himself in Isaiah: 'He has made me like a chosen arrow; He has hidden me in His quiver' (Isa 49:2). For how could the one fashioning those who are being pierced as chosen not be a chosen arrow, hidden in the quiver which He possessed from the flesh of Mary?

Once this divine bow is bent, from which the arrows that strike are released into divine love, Ephraim is struck, being overturned and shown to be weak, according to what was said by the sub-text of the Psalm: 'The sons of Ephraim, bending and shooting the bow, how were they turned back in the day of war' (Hos 7:7), when the great God, bestowing grace, raised up 'the children of Zion against the children of the Greeks' (Joel 2:28)? The generations of Greeks are signified in these things: those advocating false knowledge and all those having impiety, by which the impious send out destructive arrows against those who have not taken up 'the door of faith.' The children of Zion are those advocating the truth, being raised up by God who reigns over them.
